description: The group is geographically dispersed enough that every real candidate leaves someone over their stated comfortable travel tolerance. Leximin still picks a defensible answer — it minimizes the worst burden, it does not promise everyone comfort.

candidateVenues.name: Kfar Bat Yam Midpoint Grill
candidateVenues.note: Roughly equidistant from all three, but still ~9km for Keren and Doron — above their tolerance too, and it's the lowest-rated option.

expected.reasoning: Every candidate leaves someone over tolerance, so there is no 'solution' in the strict sense. Averaging distance would favor the midpoint venue, but leximin looks at the single worst-off participant per candidate: at Herbert Samuel, Amit's burden is high; at the midpoint venue, Keren and Doron are both moderately over tolerance and the venue is worse-rated for everyone. Agreed: Herbert Samuel Grill is the better of two uncomfortable options because it doesn't multiply the burden across two people to spare a third, even though it does not satisfy Amit's own tolerance.

claudeRecommendation.reasoning: Not a team decision — a starting proposal for the discussion, backed by the actual burden formula (spec §5.4: distance / toleranceKm). At Herbert Samuel, Amit is worst-off at roughly 13km / 8km tolerance = burden 1.625. At the midpoint venue, Keren and Doron are worst-off at roughly 9km / 5km tolerance = burden 1.8 — a higher worst-case burden, even though it looks fairer on a map, and it is also the lower-rated venue for everyone. Leximin itself, not just intuition, favors Herbert Samuel Grill. Still needs an actual three-way sign-off before it counts as agreed ground truth.
